breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The user requested a k-point grid that was simultaneously "half shifted" and "gamma-centered", which are mutually exclusive and conflicting instructions. The ground truth resolved this by removing the "gamma-centered" instruction. The agent failed to identify this conflict and repeated both contradictory instructions in its output: "Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift, gamma-centered...".
